parameters.content:
## Seed

Rows live in the Edit Fields nodes as JSON, plus the mock rows of the request body (test identities, gitignored); Split Out makes one item per row; upserts are keyed on the natural key. Run once per environment; safe to re-run (re-seeding restores the two fixture appointments).

## AR-90 Seed config

Markets, codes and prompts are data, not code: a new market is one row, a wording change is one cell. Disclosure texts are placeholders until Legal supplies the market wording. The mock rows in the body (the engagement's test identities, gitignored, sent by ar-seed.py) are upserted after the synthetic fixtures; missing columns are filled from the fixture shape.

meta.description: POST /webhook/ar/v1/admin/seed. Upserts ar_markets (PL, ES, DE, GB), ar_codes (intent and handoff reason codes), ar_prompts (goals, rules and every spoken line, per language) and the lab fixtures (customers, dealers, the two existing appointments). The body may carry mockCustomers, mockDealers and mockBookings rows to upsert on top (the test identities of the engagement, kept out of the generator). Run once per environment; safe to re-run.
